scope: Direct inspection of contact sheet, all three motion samples, selected full-size game frames, create caption/action frames, and four transition frame sequences. Continuous muted Chromium playback is separately measured; this does not claim subjective listening.
checked: Opening contains only game emblem and title; outro address is fully visible.
Room capacity states maximum 10 rooms and maximum 4 trainers per room.
Create shot uses a static 1.45x center crop; modal controls are not clipped and 1.5s text stays left of the modal.
At 5s into create the large promotional caption has faded and the league format selection is visible.
Four-member board, ordered Pokemon selection, three-member tournament bye and four-member league standings are visible.
Fade, smoothleft, smoothright and smoothup transitions have valid outgoing, blended and incoming frames without black gaps.
No dynamically animated camera zoom, shaking, added production labels, achievement promotion or VP promotion.

independentBattleReview.reviewer: capture agent independently inspected final MP4 frames
independentBattleReview.limit: The edit shows the first double-battle impact and HP change; the second attack and full KO resolution are outside this 12-second excerpt.

freezeWarningReview.reason: These intervals hold the opening/title, completed password form, four-member lobby, tournament/league tables or outro for reading. No freeze warning occurs during the single/double action segments. All 2760 frames decode; full browser playback dropped zero frames.
